titulo_ja: とおり と こうさてん
titulo_es: Place a place with a street or a crossing

むこう.en: on the other side; in front

bloques.titulo: The streets and references help to specify a route.
texto: In one direction, it combines a point of reference with its position:
(The bank is close to the crossing.)
The hospital is on the other side of the avenue.

frases.ja: ぎんこう は こうさてん の ちかく です。
frases.es: El banco está cerca del cruce.
frases.en: The bank is near the crossing.

frases.ja: びょういん は おおどおり の むこう です。
frases.es: El hospital está al otro lado de la avenida.
frases.en: The hospital is across the avenue.
